t: You're on Adelaide Road, which runs between Chalk Farm and Swiss Cottage in the London Borough of Camden. At its eastern end is Chalk Farm tube station, on the corner with Haverstock Hill, opened in nineteen oh seven. Belsize Park lies to the north and Primrose Hill to the south, and the road runs alongside Fellows Road and Eton Avenue. It's named after Queen Adelaide, the wife of William IV, who was queen from eighteen thirty to eighteen thirty-seven. It carries on westward as Belsize Road.
